name: Question 8
problem:
The position vector $r$ of a particle $P$ (relative to a fixed origin $O$) at time $t$ is given by

$$
r=⟨4\sqrt{1+t},(1+t)^{2}⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the velocity vector $v$ at time $t=3.$

The position vector r of a particle P (relative to a fixed origin O) at time t is given by r=⟨41+t,(1+t)2⟩,t>0. Calculate the velocity vector v at time t=3.

a
v(3)=⟨4,8⟩
b
v(3)=⟨2,8⟩
c
v(3)=⟨1,7⟩
d
v(3)=⟨2,7⟩
e
v(3)=⟨1,8⟩
